subject.title: Unified env var management: .env should be the single source of truth

question: Should state-dir `.env` become authoritative over generated service-env values on gateway restart, or should OpenClaw keep process/service env precedence and add conflict warnings, doctor repair, and clearer docs?
rationale: Both paths affect credential precedence and upgrade behavior, so automation should not pick the permanent auth/source-of-truth contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Keep precedence, add conflict repair
options.body: Preserve existing process/service env precedence but add restart/install conflict warnings, doctor repair, and docs that explain how stale managed values are resolved.

options.title: Make `.env` authoritative
options.body: Rebuild managed service env from state-dir `.env` on restart/reinstall with upgrade tests and a clear migration story for operator-managed values.

options.title: Document current behavior only
options.body: Leave runtime behavior unchanged and document the priority chain, accepting that users may still need to inspect service-env files when keys drift.

recommendation.title: Keep precedence, add conflict repair
recommendation.body: Preserve existing process/service env precedence but add restart/install conflict warnings, doctor repair, and docs that explain how stale managed values are resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent work in the daemon install/service-env planning and provider setup area makes this the best available routing candidate for the product decision.
